Implementation progress (TDD): RED contracts first proved missing replay capture, static converter, non-writing validation, and external matrix wiring (4 expected failures); GREEN implementation now passes 64 focused generator/corpus/hardening/workflow tests. Canonical artifacts cover 178 bodies and 1,383 ordered real-Pandoc conversions (code_arrow 445, table 504, prose 434) in three files of 205.0/202.3/261.5 KiB, each below the 500 KiB gate. The Verify tier drives production segmentation through a fail-closed static hash-to-exact-output converter, retains all safety/richness/settling/alignment/byte assertions, and runs evidence-selected live bodies code_arrow[0], table[2], prose[0]. The external job uses a weekly/manual ubuntu-latest + macos-latest matrix and runs the non-writing complete replay command.

The non-writing command passed locally: 1,383 real conversions and 684,843 committed bytes matched. Paired same-host exact command: origin/main baseline 51 tests / 41.00s pytest / 42s shell; implementation 34 tests / 3.79s pytest / 4s shell, a 90.8% wall reduction while replacing chunk cases with complete static trace/body assertions rather than dropping units. make lint, actionlint, and mypy (540 files) pass. Full default gate and Gerrit evidence remain.
